title: Persistent player profile (localStorage MVP) — stable playerId + lifetime stats
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-27-009 (should-priority, KABOOM-CREW-MVP-2). Foundation for future cosmetic unlocks + cross-session match history. Lands a pure-additive localStorage layer: stable playerId, lifetime stats (matches, rounds, pickups, chains, self-deaths), per-kind pickup counter. No existing system changes — only NEW data persistence.
Privacy stance documented explicitly in the module header + README: localStorage is per-origin per-browser; nothing leaves the user's machine; the user can clear it via browser tools at will.

- deathsByOwnBomb + chainReactionsTriggered + maxChainLength counters are SHIPPED in the store API (recordSelfDeath, recordChain) but the bootstrap event-hook for them is deferred to a follow-up. Round + match + pickup hooks ARE wired this sprint.
- preferredRecipeSeed field present in the schema but no recipe-reapplication path yet — opens the door without committing the wiring.
- ?showLifetime=true HUD indicator deferred. Agent probes (getProfile / setProfileStats / resetProfile) cover the v1 inspection surface.

stories.title: profile-store module with localStorage persistence + debounced writes
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/profile/profile-store.ts (NEW). createProfileStore({ storage, now, genId, setTimeoutFn, clearTimeoutFn }) returns { get, load, flush, incrementStat, setStats, recordRoundOutcome, recordMatchOutcome, recordPickup, recordChain, recordSelfDeath, reset }. Stored under key 'kaboom.player.profile.v1'. Schema version mismatch + corrupt JSON fall back to defaults with a console.warn. 2-second write debounce batches rapid stat bumps; flush() forces immediate persistence. Default profile uses crypto.randomUUID() (with a Math.random fallback for older test envs).
verification: acceptance: profile-store.ts ships the 11-method ProfileStore interface. createProfileStore handles empty storage, missing key, schema version mismatch, corrupt JSON. Debounced writes; flush() forces a write. 16 unit tests in profile-store.test.ts cover the full API.

stories.title: Bootstrap event hooks for round-resolve + match-resolve + pickup-collect
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — instantiate the profile store at attachUi (passing window.localStorage). Per-frame snapshot loop tracks prev round/match phase + number and emits recordRoundOutcome / recordMatchOutcome on the 'playing → won|lost|draw|resolved' transition (guarded against double-count by the round/match number tie). pickup-collect detection (the existing S148 wasHere flow for the tooltip) also calls profileStore.recordPickup(kind). Self-death + chain-reaction hooks deferred to a follow-up sprint.
verification: acceptance: bootstrap.ts wires profileStore to round + match transitions + pickup-collect. prevRoundPhase + prevRoundNumber detect a single resolve event per round; match-resolved detected similarly. The S148 tooltip wasHere flow also bumps the per-kind pickup counter.

stories.title: Agent probes — getProfile / setProfileStats / resetProfile
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts — three new entries on the runtime.kaboom + window.__agf.kaboom surface. getProfile() returns the live profile. setProfileStats(partial) overrides counters + flushes immediately (QA / fixture use). resetProfile() clears the localStorage entry + drops the in-memory state.
verification: acceptance: __agf.kaboom.getProfile() returns the live PlayerProfile object; setProfileStats({roundsWon: 10}) updates + persists; resetProfile() wipes storage + the next getProfile() returns a fresh playerId.

stories.title: Unit tests covering the profile-store API end-to-end
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/profile-store.test.ts (NEW) — 16 tests: default-on-empty, memoised playerId, load-from-storage roundtrip with lastSeenAt refresh, schema version mismatch + corrupt JSON fall back to defaults (with console.warn), debounced writes + flush, recordRoundOutcome, recordMatchOutcome, recordPickup, recordChain (max tracking), recordSelfDeath, setStats partial replace, reset() flow, unknown-key forward-compat, 'pickupsCollected.X' sub-key route, undefined-storage in-memory mode.
verification: acceptance: profile-store.test.ts — 16 tests pass; covers every record* method + the edge cases (mismatch, corrupt, undefined storage, unknown key). 1727/1727 full vitest suite green.
